<!-- pr-reviewer: 289cdfea79d40ad950c895264719392c90aedd09 -->
Needs changes before merge.

The Side Burn posting checks pass. Two required review items remain open.

What looks good:

- The post requires an explicit lateral template with all four placeholders.
- The safety checks refuse incomplete coordinates, diagonal travel, changing Z, invalid feed, and moves below program resolution.
- The unit and work-offset tests cover both lateral endpoints and feed conversion.
- I checked all 24 new NC golden lines against the recorded CL and the synthetic machine dialect.
  The straight burn, Side Burn plunge, two 0.15 mm lateral legs, feed, and rapid retract agree.
  No existing NC or CL golden changed.
- The decision record, provenance, `Process change: yes`, and `Changelog:` line are present.
  The PR does not edit `PROCESS_VERSION`.

Local results:

The PR was trial-merged with upstream main `a955bce28d25af230cef24f152ae08bb0e34f886` in `.claude/worktrees/review-3027`.
The merge was clean. All builds and tests ran locally in the foreground. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | PASS: 116 steps; 936 tests; no failed or ignored tests |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` | PASS |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`, from `crates/ui` | PASS: 1,318 tests; seven ignored tests |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` | FAIL: 199 steps; one unexpected failure; 39.3 minutes |

Heavy results: 40 tests passed. Six known-fail checks failed at their expected assertions.
One additional test failed in `app heavy: pocket3d_hsm`. The table below lists every reached step.

Extra suites run:

The changed fixture is under `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/sinker-iso/`.
I searched its direct readers and the shared recorded-test helper.
I ran both sinker suites explicitly, in addition to the quick gate:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-post --test script_sinker_iso`: 22 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post --test script_sinker_side`: 10 passed.

No importer code or STEP fixture changed. The extra importer suites do not apply.

Safety mutations:

| Mutation | Red result | Restored result |
|---|---|---|
| Remove the required-placeholder guard | `side_burn_requires_explicit_complete_machine_dialect` failed, exit 101 | Passed, exit 0 |
| Remove the axis and constant-Z guard | `side_burn_refuses_diagonal_and_combined_vertical_lateral_moves` failed, exit 101 | Passed, exit 0 |

Both mutation edits were restored. No source change or review artifact was committed to the PR branch.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/post/src/machine/edm_codes.rs:33`: Add before/after screenshots of the sinker machine editor to the PR body.
   The new `side` entry adds a visible `Code side` row through `crates/ui/src/egui_app/machine_edm_editor.rs:195`.
   The body has no screenshots. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch, and link them.
2. `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs:144`: Restore a green result for the required heavy check and record it in the PR body.
   `the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean` fails the Linux path-count assertion.
   The test produces `(3158, 3130, 1141)`; the Linux pin expects `(4726, 4698, 549)`.
   I reproduced the same failure on unmodified main `a955bce28d25af230cef24f152ae08bb0e34f886` and on newer main `768fe23f0`.
   This is a baseline gate failure. The evidence does not establish a regression from this PR.
   The current Heavy lanes at review rule still requires a green reached heavy test before readiness.

Failure text:

```text
thread 'the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean' panicked at crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs:144:5:
the bore's path as the fix plans it: (3158, 3130, 1141)
test result: FAILED. 0 passed; 1 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 2 filtered out
```

Notes:

No real EDM control or physical cut was tested. No real machine dialect was added.
Upstream main advanced during the review. The trial-merge results above name the exact base that ran.
The PR head remained unchanged. This review does not approve or merge the PR.
